editorial.blurb: Chubby Cattle BBQ brings high-end Wagyu and Japanese-inspired cuts to Chicago's Chinatown with exceptional service and interactive tableside cooking.
editorial.insiderTip: Book the Gold tier AYCE if Silver feels limited, arrive early for reservations (waits happen even with bookings), and let your server help cook the premium Wagyu cuts while you handle the rest—order generously and frequently to maximize the experience.
